title: Basmachi movement
summary: Wikidata item Q255352, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "decentralized decolonial movement which undertook a uprising against Russian Imperial and Soviet rule by the Muslim peoples of Central Asia (1916–1934)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
